topic_title: Emergency Control: Skids, Blowouts & Brake Failure
prompt: If your right wheels drop off the paved road onto a low shoulder, how should you return to the highway?

options.text: Jerk steering wheel hard to the left immediately while braking hard
Accelerate rapidly and steer into the ditch to bounce back onto asphalt
Hold wheel straight, ease off gas, slow down, check traffic, steer back smoothly
Pull the emergency parking brake lever immediately while turning wheels
